title: Local and global strong solutions to a reduced model for inviscid micropolar fluids
summary: This paper investigates the well-posedness issue for a reduced two-dimensional model of micropolar fluids. This reduced model presents a coupling between an Euler-type equation for the velocity field of the fluid and a transport-diffusion equation for the microrotation field (which is a scalar field, in this setting). We establish the local existence and uniqueness of strong solutions in the scale of Besov space $B^s_{p,1}$ having regularity index $s\geq1+2/p$.
